messages:
Isha Desai: Hey all! Isha here  Joined today on Product Growth. Remote from Oakland but planning to be in SF once a month. I knit and play Catan aggressively. Also partial to late-night ramen runs. :)
Lena Ortiz: Welcome Isha!! :wave: Knitting + Catan = instant friend. Where in Oakland are you?
Isha Desai: East Oakland near Fruitvale. Commuting is easy enough by BART. Also: is there a designated quiet knitting corner or is that a myth?
Markus Feld: Welcome!! We have a chill corner by the third-floor windows where people eat and some knit sometimes. Heads-up: it gets sunniest in the afternoon (good for plants).
Rina Sato: Hi Isha  welcome! We do a casual boardgame night every other Thursday in the lounge. Cataners are welcome but you might face fierce wool-trading competition. :game_die:
Ben Rogers: FYI badge lockers: row C, combos start with 7. Theres a bike pump in the garage. For ramen runs, the 3rd-street spot next to the laundromat is open late and does a good veggie tonkotsu.
Isha Desai: Ooh boardgame night sounds perfect. I also bring tiny knitted things for coworkers like keychain mushrooms. Hope thats okay to leave around?
Lena Ortiz: Absolutely yes, tiny knitted mushrooms approved. :mushroom: We usually put free desk-stuff on the community shelf.
Rina Sato: Poll: Thursday boardgame night snack preference? Vote with :chips: for chips/pretzels or :ramen: for ramen at 7pm.
Markus Feld: :chips: (but if ramen happens Ill never say no)
Isha Desai: :ramen: I will happily bring an emergency cup noodle stash just in case.
welcome-bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires: "Say hi to Isha Desai  Product Growth  Oakland/SF"
Isha Desai: Thanks everyone  excited to meet folks (and knit at the windows).
